_readme: This file is READY to ingest your planned itinerary. Fill in the dates and locations below, and the planner's budget calculator + day planner will automatically use them. The app also reads a good default from the values here.

trip.name: South Korea Trip
trip.note: Arrive Oct 31 21:00 at ICN. Oct 31 arrival night intentionally left unbooked (decision 2026-08-17). Booked nights: Nov 1–21, checkout Nov 22 (21 nights).

legs.note: Refundable-rate captures for these exact dates live in data/pricing-history.json. Oct 31 arrival night is unbooked — see guide/arrival-night.md if that changes.

locations: Old Town / Hwangnam-dong (hanok village, near tombs)
legs.note: No subway in Gyeongju - KTX arrives at Singyeongju, ~20 min taxi/bus to town.
Consider splitting Busan between Haeundae and Busan Station.

alternatives.note: Recommended third city: direct on Seoul–Busan KTX corridor. Excellent cost + transport balance. 7 hotels available in data/hotels.json.
Strong alternative third city: larger city with hot springs and more dining options. 7 hotels available in data/hotels.json.
